# Kuailu Smart Office is accredited with a letter-based conversion of the AI Smart Body Empowerment Enterprise!

- Dissemination channel: Interface News (central media)
- Original link: [https://www.jiemian.com/article/14096884.html](https://www.jiemian.com/article/14096884.html]

## Text
The transformation of the country in the area of smart offices is not only about our information security line, but also about the path to the rise of domestic software. In recent days, Kuailu has successfully tested and evaluated its own self-study product, and its functionality, performance, safety and compatibility have successfully passed the testing and certification of the team of experts of the Shenzhen City Creativity Institute. This certification marks the emergence of Kuailu as an industry leader in autonomous, secure and nationally compatible offices, and as a national software pioneer to protect the national production of smart offices.

It's perfect for the country's environment.

In recent years, there has been a trend towards the replacement of domestic production in the area of smart office. Nationalization of key areas of information technology is a central tool for safeguarding the country and the autonomy and control of enterprise information technology. In the CBI (Innovation of Information Technology Applications) certification, the State will conduct authoritative assessments of the functions, performance, compatibility and safety of nationally produced hardware and software products. The certified product means that it can operate in an ecologically sound manner in the form of domestically produced chips (e.g., thorium, fly-off), operating systems (e.g., UOS, tritium) and is eligible for government procurement, bidding, etc.

The evaluation was conducted by a third-party testing agency, which conducted a full-specific validation test in a rigorous, creative environment, using a nationally produced central processor (ZHAOXIN KaiXian KX-U6780A@2.7GHz) and carrying the Galaxy desktop operating system. In such a state-wide software and hardware environment, Kuailu ' s intelligent office products are operating steadily and performably, and all functional indicators have been successfully tested to fully validate their high compatibility and excellent performance in the basic domestic software and hardware architecture.

Continue to invest in research and development and contribute to the process of national production substitution

In response to the request of the National Innovation Project for the replacement and upgrading of national production, Kuailu ' s smart office has continuously increased its investment in research and development resources in order to create a stable bottom-up structure that is consistent with data, covering many core scenarios such as procurement, manpower, production, etc. To date, Kuailu ' s smart office has been successfully deployed to a number of industry clients with the desired results. At the same time, the Kuailu Smart Office also provides letter support and security services to business users, promotes the successful implementation of the national innovation initiative in key sectors and maintains national industrial information security.

The Kuailu Smart Office has been responding positively to the National Information Security Strategy and has been fully involved in the development of the Creative Commons. During the critical window period of the accelerated fall of AI technology, Kuailu ' s Smart Office works to build a one-stop AI smart office system, driven by AI smart body, integrating AI office, AI collaboration, AI conference-wide office ecology, covering the entire business landscape of personnel, finance, procurement, administration and CRM, interoperating with business-wide data, activating human, financial and material core data assets, transforming data into smart productivity and enabling enterprises to achieve low-cost, efficient and integrated office intelligence.

It's a sign of renewed confidence.

This award is an authoritative recognition of Kuailu ' s intellectual office self-research and development skills and of its influence in the area of national production. In the future, Kuailu ' s Smart Office will continue to focus on precision farming in the field of innovation, deepen the potential for technological research and development, steadily improve product performance and safety, actively expand the boundaries of the application landscape and respond to industry ' s pressing needs for accelerated replacement of national production.

At the same time, Kuailu ' s Smart Office will actively engage in communication with CICIG and other member organizations, working hand in hand to contribute to the flourishing of the ICT industry, providing secure, efficient and intelligent cloud-based collaborative solutions to government and business users, and contributing to its rapid development.
